# Khanna Vision

> Khanna Vision is a vision correction and eye care institute serving patients in Southern California, with locations in Beverly Hills and Westlake Village, California. Khanna Vision provides information and services related to vision correction, laser eye surgery, lens-based vision correction, cataract surgery, and ophthalmic care.

Khanna Vision is the organization represented by the website https://khannainstitute.com/. The website provides information about vision correction procedures, eye care services, physicians, treatment options, patient resources, locations, and educational content.

The primary service area is Southern California, with locations in Beverly Hills and Westlake Village, California. The primary physician associated with Khanna Vision is Dr. Rajesh Khanna.

The website covers vision correction and ophthalmic services including SMILE Pro laser vision correction, SMILE laser vision correction, LASIK, SuperLASIK, EVO ICL, presbyopia treatment, lens-based vision correction, cataract surgery, and other eye-care services.
